title: I don't think @facebook folk totally to blame. Know many engineers who had brilliant ideas... But marketing... But really think @facebook lost control
summary: I don't think @facebook folk totally to blame. Know many engineers who had brilliant ideas... But marketing... But really think @facebook lost control. Just beg @facebook to shut down all their properties until after election.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I don't think @facebook folk totally to blame. Know many engineers who had brilliant ideas... But marketing... But really think @facebook lost control.

Just beg @facebook to shut down all their properties until after election.
